notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Local plates are short and have no blue strip on the left.

notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Many cars from the large neighbour to the west show up, often with old yellow back plates because the coverage is so old.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Dense apartment blocks with neoclassical details and pastel colours, similar to the southern coast of France or northern Italy but more luxurious.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: A city-state with essentially no rural land; it is hilly, and the few unbuilt patches show Mediterranean vegetation.

notes.subject: coverage
notes.text: A lot of the coverage runs inside road tunnels.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Rows of parked mopeds line the streets.

notes.subject: coverage
notes.text: A Generation 3 trekker on a boat in the harbour shows yachts, the skyline and hills; it is common in competitive modes.
